summary: Fixed repos widget to correctly show push target using Option C (infer from branch name pattern). fleet/ branches now map to push_target='main' with green badge; non-fleet branches show the actual branch name with yellow badge. Updated queries.py (startswith fleet/ logic), template (show rc.push_target instead of hardcoded 'branch'), test_queries.py (verify fleet/ → main, others → actual branch), and added 2 new tests in test_templates.py.
